decisions.reason: This simple net price display plugin is very close to the firm's core shop-extension work and likely cheap to maintain, so despite weak visibility since 2020 it still retains some option value.

After several years and no recent website presence, the remaining learning value of this price comparison tracking plugin looks limited while upkeep against external comparison channels likely makes it costlier to keep open.

The net price reporting plugin is adjacent to existing capabilities but by 2022 its market signal appears too weak to justify further standalone attention when resources can be shifted to the established business and newer developments.
